description: This file defines a configuration storage module that manages local and remote configuration overrides. It uses actors for concurrency control and provides methods to load and save configuration data through different mechanisms, including a remote gateway and local storage.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class that holds and manages configuration override settings.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the configuration data, either from remote or local sources depending on the mode.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided configuration data either remotely or locally.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches configuration from a remote gateway.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Saves configuration data to a remote gateway.
